weights.blocker: Both the local host and px2 failed to establish HTTPS connections to the author Google Drive. Local gdown/urllib returned connection refused; px2 urllib returned Errno 99 and curl timed out. No official per-file IDs, checksums, or alternate author weight URLs were available in the pinned source. Third-party mirrors and previously cached uncertified weights are forbidden.
weights.required_unblock: Download ufold_train_alldata.pt (and preferably every file in the author folder) through the exact author Drive URL on a network with Google Drive access; retain Drive file ID/metadata, compute SHA256 independently, verify strict U_Net(img_ch=17) state-dict loading on CPU, and update this manifest and EXPECTED_CHECKPOINT_SHA256 before any gated GPU run.

dataset.name: bpRNA-new5388
dataset.input_contract: JSONL name/seq/pairs; ACGU only; zero-based inclusive i<j; canonical AU/CG/GU; j-i>3; one partner per base
dataset.output_contract: JSONL in input order with exactly {name, pairs}; pairs retain the same zero-based i<j convention; atomic 5388-row output and manifest only after strict checkpoint authentication

runtime_contract.feature_channels: 16 ordered AUCG outer products plus one official creatmat coupling channel
runtime_contract.length_padding: official get_cut_len(length,80): minimum 80 then next multiple of 16; maximum for this dataset is 496

resource_requirements.basis: Batch-one maximum tensor side 496 and 8,641,377 parameters; 4 GiB is a conservative launch reservation, not a measured minimum.
resource_requirements.cpu_feature_preparation: NumPy/SciPy/scikit-learn/pandas plus PyTorch; official creatmat uses CPU only when CUDA is hidden during CPU tests

training_exposure.scope: External Test is restricted to protocol audit and cannot be used for model selection
training_exposure.evidence: ufold/utils.py get_args default train_files and ufold_train.py iteration over train_files; ufold_predict.py selects models/ufold_train_alldata.pt
training_exposure.caveat: No official per-weight lineage manifest is published. The all-data filename and current default training list are recorded without claiming independent proof of the checkpoint's exact training samples.
